author: tomayt0

comments.author: tomayt0
comments.body:
OP Here:

This is a pet project using Claude Code and Pi Coding agent over a period of a few months on and off.

What you see here is animations curated from opensource libraries like Adobe Mixamo.

Opensource CCO weapons

The operatives and terrorists were generated using Meshy.ai

I am a Java software engineer so I wanted to stick with that as a language. I came across the JmonkeyEngine - https://jmonkeyengine.org/

Its a mature game engine and was straightforward to pickup using AI.

The final part is the map making using Blender and Pi agent to take screenshots and use 2D architectural layouts to place buildings, stairs, windows, doorways etc.

The blender map making process was surprisingly not too bad on token usage.
